title: Inject the configured OTP into the payment integration fixture
decisions: Keep the OTP exclusively in the integration-test fixture as a test constant; production code retains no fallback OTP.
Construct the fixture payment service with the same explicit OTP injection contract used by production composition.
Replace the stale hardcoded request OTP in the payment integration test with the fixture constant so the expected forbidden, validation, creation, and duplicate-payment behavior remains covered.
compatibility: No production API or payment behavior changes. This fixes the integration fixture so a valid payment request reaches the existing ownership and payment state assertions instead of failing OTP validation with HTTP 400.
